about_the_game:
Follow Marianne, a young debutante in an alternative Regency England, where unique opportunities arise. Take part in “the great experiment”, as you navigate intrigue, romance, and life-changing decisions. Will you help Marianne find love, secure a prestigious place in high society… or achieve both? 

Her destiny is in your hands in this story-driven adventure filled with secrets and endless possibilities.

Make Decisions and build her future.

Love in Match is a visual novel with multiple finals. You will choose the path that will follow Marianne. Each decision will build her personality and affect the course of the story. You will also build relationships based on previous interactions.

Love romance

With the season comes romance and the passion flourish for a young debutante like Marianne. But not every person can catch the attention of such a beautiful intelligent woman.

  • Meet Ezra, a young intelligent well positioned aristocrat, who is also a childhood friend of Marianne. Sweet, supportive and charming, who wanted more!

  • Or Alexandra, a mysterious rich noblewoman, with whom Marianne does not stop meeting. It will be the beginning of a beautiful friendship... or something else...

  • Be stuck with Guy, a thug who Marianne's father assigned to her to keep her safe. Is she going to be safe or will she walk into the lion's den?

Will you get love, or will you trade it for power or money… Her decision is yours.

content_descriptors.notes: Please be aware that you can unlock scenes with nudes and sex.
